mapper.select: select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,b.LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate, b.POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime,b.BIRTH_DAY as birthDay,b.USER_TYPE as userType,b.COMPANY as company from HR_SALARY_ATTEND a left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD b on a.STANDARD_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,b.LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate, b.POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime,b.BIRTH_DAY as birthDay,b.USER_TYPE as userType,b.COMPANY as company from HR_SALARY_ATTEND a left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD b on a.STANDARD_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}

select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,b.LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate, b.POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime,b.BIRTH_DAY as birthDay,b.USER_TYPE as userType,b.COMPANY as company from HR_SALARY_ATTEND a join HR_SALARY_STANDARD b on a.STANDARD_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.`YEAR_MONTH` like CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '%') and b.USER_ID = #{userId} order by b.`YEAR_MONTH`
